prompt:
Draw ONE complete full-colour manga PAGE, portrait, read left to right, with exactly FOUR panels, black panel borders, thin white gutters and a small white page margin. Style: approachable Indian slice-of-life manga, clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural light, simple readable backgrounds, expressive natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. BALLOON SPACE: in EVERY panel keep the upper quarter as plain empty background (plain wall, ceiling or sky) with no faces, hands, screens or important objects in it; speech balloons and captions are added there later. Keep heads below that band. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, words, numbers, speech balloons, captions, sound effects, signage text, logos, brand marks or watermarks. Do not draw any Welbuk logo, and no heart, cross or medical-cross symbols anywhere: buildings, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and icons never show a cross or plus sign. Screens show only simple abstract interface shapes: a hot-pink (#FD006A) header bar, white cards, grey lines, simple icons and charts; never readable text or numbers. All data is fictional.

REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 = main-cast.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels); Image 2 = nurse.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels); Image 3 = pharmacy-lab.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels); Image 4 = vision-cast.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels).

CAST ON THIS PAGE:
ANANYA: Dr. Ananya, Indian woman, late 30s, clinic owner and doctor; black hair in a low bun with a few loose strands, small gold stud earrings, teal kurta under an open white coat, stethoscope around her neck; calm almond eyes, level brows, oval face.
MEERA: Meera, Indian woman, late 20s, receptionist; long black single braid over her LEFT shoulder, blue block-print kurta, thin silver bangle on her right wrist; large round eyes, high thin brows, round face.
NURSE: the Nurse, Indian woman, early 30s; chin-length wavy black bob tucked behind her right ear, plain LAVENDER scrub top and trousers, lavender lanyard with a blank card, small watch on her left wrist.
PHARMACIST: the Pharmacist, Indian man, early 40s; short wavy black hair greying at the temples, neat moustache, white coat over a light blue shirt.
LABTECH: the Lab Technician, Indian woman, mid 20s; neat high bun, thin round glasses, light-blue lab coat over a navy top, purple gloves.
RAVI: Ravi, Indian man, mid 30s, patient; short neat black hair with side part, short trimmed beard, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, wristwatch on his LEFT wrist; thick straight brows, square jaw.
PARTNER: Ravi's partner, Indian woman, early 30s; shoulder-length wavy hair, mustard-yellow kurta, small mole under her right eye.
CHILD: Ravi's child, about seven; short hair, round cheeks, orange T-shirt.

PAGE LAYOUT: Panel 1 full-width at the top (about 35% of the page height); panels 2 and 3 side by side in the middle (about 30%); panel 4 full-width at the bottom (about 35%).

PANELS (left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading order):
Panel 1: Wide: the clinic team working together in one bright space: Dr. Ananya, Meera, the Nurse, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician, each at their task, smiling.
Panel 2: A clean white panel with three empty pink rounded rectangles stacked, each with a simple icon (a laptop, a group of people, a person with a heart-free phone icon). Leave large clean white space.
Panel 3: Soft vision vignette: a network of small round icons (plain clinic buildings with no cross, a pill bottle for a pharmacy, a lab flask, a family) linked by dotted pink lines.
Panel 4: Final full-width scene in front of the clinic: Dr. Ananya welcoming a patient, staff in the doorway, Ravi with his partner and child smiling. Keep the upper third as clean sky for the logo.

PAGE NOTES: Final page. Panel 2 is left mostly empty for the real logo; panel 3 is a soft vision vignette.
